name: email
description: Send and read emails. Requires SMTP/IMAP configuration via environment variables (NLS_SMTP_HOST, NLS_SMTP_USER, NLS_SMTP_PASS).

manual.overview: Use email when you need to send formal messages, documents, or updates to specific recipients, or when you need to read/search inbox for user context. Prefer it for async, durable communication that requires a paper trail.

examples.description: Fetch the 5 most recent inbox messages

tips: Always set a clear subject line for send actions to improve deliverability and open rates
For read/search, use limit to avoid fetching too many messages and slowing the agent
Prefer plain text body for reliability; HTML may be stripped or misrendered by some clients
Double-check recipient addresses before sending to avoid misdelivery
edge_cases: SMTP credentials must be correct and the server must allow relay from your IP; otherwise sends will fail silently or with auth errors
Some providers (Gmail, Outlook) require app passwords or OAuth; verify env vars match your provider requirements
Reading from IMAP may fail if the mailbox is large or connection is slow; use small limits
